question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Wax
solution:
The correct answer is:** Wane**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wax** means to grow larger or increase. (बड़ा होना या बढ़ना)

 
 
• **Example -** *She **waxed** nostalgic at the reunion.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Wane** means to grow smaller or decrease. (छोटा होना या कम होना)
 
 
• **Example -** *His interest in the game was **waning**.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that** 'Wax'** and** 'Wane' **are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mourn** means to feel regret or sadness about the loss or disappearance of something. (विलाप)
 
• **Error** means the state or condition of being wrong in conduct or judgement. (गलती)
 
• **Insolent** means showing a rude and arrogant lack of respect. (ढीठ)
